name: tether_v007_cuda
hypothesis: Transfer V005 weights into geometry-aware navigation; wider routes, adaptive corner tracking and destination metrics may reduce collisions while PPO learns disturbance compensation.
algorithm: SB3 PPO residual motor control with geometric route planner
notes: Transfer initialization from V005 best plus matching normalizer, new optimizer run. CF2.1 + Flow/AI decks user-confirmed. Rotor/deck primitive collision volumes, all-substep obstacle contacts, full cable-geom clearance. Assumed physics ranges, no measured thrust/cable/inertia fit. Known static geometry and state; no vision or hardware flight. New held-out seeds; v1 results are not directly comparable after simulator/task changes. CUDA continuation from V006 interruption; eight CPU simulator workers; batch size 1024. Optimizer and normalization preserved. Throughput not yet benchmarked against CPU.
